name: rentemester-workspace-document-inbox-v25
sql:
CREATE TABLE rm_workspace_inbox_sources (
 source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 visibility_anchor_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 original_bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
 sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 mime_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 transport TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(transport IN ('upload','mail','connector')),
 transport_identity TEXT,
 received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rm_workspace_inbox_sources_anchor_hash_identity ON rm_workspace_inbox_sources(visibility_anchor_slug, sha256, transport, COALESCE(transport_identity,''));
CREATE TABLE rm_workspace_inbox_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rm_workspace_inbox_sources(source_id),
 event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('ingested','candidate_resolved','exception_opened','assigned','handoff_completed','reassignment_denied')),
 payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 canonical_payload TEXT NOT NULL,
 actor TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TRIGGER rm_workspace_inbox_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON rm_workspace_inbox_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workspace inbox events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_workspace_inbox_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON rm_workspace_inbox_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workspace inbox events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TABLE rm_workspace_inbox_assignments (
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rm_workspace_inbox_sources(source_id),
 company_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('approved','completed')),
 document_id INTEGER,
 document_no TEXT,
 assigned_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 assigned_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 completed_at TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(source_id, company_slug)
);
CREATE TABLE rm_workspace_inbox_exceptions (
 source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES rm_workspace_inbox_sources(source_id),
 code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(code IN ('INBOX_NO_CANDIDATE','INBOX_AMBIGUOUS_CANDIDATES','INBOX_ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT')),
 required_action TEXT NOT NULL,
 opened_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 resolved_at TEXT
);
